project_type: Expo React Native mobile app + React Vite web app monorepo
build_system: Expo CLI for mobile, Vite for web, Bun for package management
test_framework: expo lint for mobile, eslint + vitest for web
build_command: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android
verification_instructions: 1. Run cd apps/mobile && npx expo lint (exit 0). 2. Run cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform android (exit 0). 3. Run cd apps/web && npm run lint (exit 0). 4. Run cd apps/web && npm run build (exit 0).
setup_instructions: cd apps/mobile && bun install; cd apps/web && bun install
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js v22, Bun 1.2.14. No iOS testing (Android only). Expo SDK 52 / React Native 0.76.7. No TypeScript type checking (tsconfig exists but all files are .jsx/.js).
contribution_requirements: Dark mode ONLY. No download functionality. No light theme. All user-visible strings must use t() translation function from i18n. Genre/Country browsing via tabbed UI. ContentRail uses horizontal ScrollView. ContentGrid uses FlatList. TVFocusable wrapper required for all pressable elements (TV remote support).
key_patterns: Components use StyleSheet.create(). TVFocusable wraps all pressable elements. Theme tokens from src/theme.js (colors, spacing, borderRadius, typography). API client in src/utils/api.js returns {items: [], page, total_pages}. Items have: id, title, poster_url, backdrop_url, rating, year, genre (comma-separated string). expo-router file-based routing. useLocalSearchParams for route params. useTranslation() hook for i18n.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/mobile/ (Expo RN with expo-router file-based routing in src/app/), apps/web/ (React + Vite SPA), apps/server/ (API server). Mobile src/ has: app/ (routes), components/ (14 shared components), i18n/ (7 locale JSON files + provider), utils/ (api, cache, player, storage, language), theme.js.
